title: warm croatian fish bisque
description: a hearty and comforting soup originating from croatia, flavored with nutmeg and topped with a shaving of bonito

ingredients.name: fish bones
ingredients.notes: any white fish works well, such as cod or haddock

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.notes: such as chardonnay or sauvignon blanc

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
add the chopped onion, garlic, fennel, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
add the fish bones and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
add the fish stock, nutmeg, and bay leaves, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the soup has reduced slightly and the flavors have melded together.
season with salt and pepper to taste.
serve hot, topped with a shaving of bonito and a sprinkle of chopped parsley, if desired.
